TextView.android:text:
1. Log in with your email and password, or tap Continue with Google.

2. New accounts must be approved by an administrator before you can log in.

3. Home shows totals for students, volunteers, programs, sessions and donations.

4. Tap a menu button (Students, Volunteers, Programs, Sessions, Enrolments, Attendance, Performance, Donations) to see its records.

5. Settings: choose dark or light theme, large text, and whether the banner slider shows. Tap Save settings.

6. Tap Logout on the home screen or Log out in Settings to sign out.

If you see 'Cannot reach server', check your internet connection and that the website is running.
